subject: general
question: Which Indian space mission marked the successful launch of 104 satellites in a single mission?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PSLV-C37**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **PSLV-C37** was an Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) mission that successfully launched 104 satellites on **15 February 2017**.
 
• This mission set a world record for launching the highest number of satellites in a single mission.
 
• The primary payload of the PSLV-C37 was **Cartosat-2D**, an Earth observation satellite.
 
• The rocket also carried 103 nanosatellites, including 96 from the United States, showcasing India’s growing capabilities in low-cost satellite launches.
 
• The PSLV (Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle) has been ISRO's workhorse for launching satellites into Sun-synchronous orbits.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cartosat-2 Series Satellites:**

 
 
• The Cartosat-2D satellite was designed for high-resolution Earth observation, including urban and rural planning, disaster management, and natural resource monitoring.
 
• The satellite had a resolution of up to **0.6 meters**, making it capable of capturing detailed images of Earth.
 
 
 
• **Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle (PSLV):**
 
 
• PSLV is India’s third-generation launch vehicle, developed by ISRO.
 
• It has had a consistently high success rate since its first successful flight in October 1994.
 
• The PSLV is versatile and can launch satellites into both geostationary and polar orbits.
 
 
 
• **International Cooperation:**
 
 
• The PSLV-C37 mission included nanosatellites from various countries, highlighting India's role in the global space economy.
 
• Among the 104 satellites, 96 were from the USA, while others came from countries like Israel, Kazakhstan, the UAE, and the Netherlands.
 
 
 
• **ISRO's Achievements:**
 
 
• ISRO has become a key player in the global satellite launch market due to its cost-effective and reliable services.
 
• The success of PSLV-C37 reinforced India's reputation for innovation and efficiency in space technology.
